metadata.question: Does nitrogen dioxide concentration in Wuhan city, China decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 data (tropospheric NO2 column) - Location: Wuhan city, China (approximately 30.6°N, 114.3°E) - Date ranges: January 1-20, 2020 and February 10-25, 2020 - The question asks if Feb 10-25 NO2 < Jan 1-20 NO2 (decrease) 2. **Masking strategy**: - Sentinel-5P data has quality flags; filter by QA values >= 0.75 - No cloud masking needed as this is column data, but apply quality filtering - Average NO2 concentrations for each period 3. **Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Check if collections are empty (size == 0) → C1 - After filtering, check pixel counts > 0 → C2 - Validate NO2 values are in reasonable range (0-500 μmol/m²) - Compare means: if Feb mean < Jan mean → A, else → B - If calculation returns None/NaN → C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Wuhan city geometry const wuhan = ee.Geometry.Point([114.3055, 30.5928]).buffer(50000); // ~50km radius // January 1-20, 2020 const jan_start = '2020-01-01'; const jan_end = '2020-01-21'; const col_jan = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/TROPOMI_L3_NO2') .filterDate(jan_start, jan_end) .filterBounds(wuhan); const jan_size = col_jan.size().getInfo(); console.log(`January (1-20): Images found = ${jan_size}`); // February 10-25, 2020 const feb_start = '2020-02-10'; const feb_end = '2020-02-26'; const col_feb = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/TROPOMI_L3_NO2') .filterDate(feb_start, feb_end) .filterBounds(wuhan); const feb_size = col_feb.size().getInfo(); console.log(`February (10-25): Images found = ${feb_size}`); // Check if collections are empty if (jan_size === 0 || feb_size === 0) { console.log('No data available for one or both periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Extract NO2 column density (NO2_column_number_density band) and apply QA filtering const jan_masked = col_jan .map(function(img) { const qa = img.select('qa_value'); return img.select('NO2_column_number_density').updateMask(qa.gte(0.75)); }) .mean(); const feb_masked = col_feb .map(function(img) { const qa = img.select('qa_value'); return img.select('NO2_column_number_density').updateMask(qa.gte(0.75)); }) .mean(); // Count valid pixels const jan_count = jan_masked .reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.count(), wuhan, 1000, 1e9 ) .get('NO2_column_number_density') .getInfo(); const feb_count = feb_masked .reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.count(), wuhan, 1000, 1e9 ) .get('NO2_column_number_density') .getInfo(); console.log(`January valid pixels: ${jan_count}`); console.log(`February valid pixels: ${feb_count}`); // Check if valid pixels exist if (jan_count === 0 || feb_count === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after QA filtering.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate mean NO2 concentration for each period (convert to μmol/m²) const jan_mean = jan_masked .reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.mean(), wuhan, 1000, 1e9 ) .get('NO2_column_number_density') .getInfo(); const feb_mean = feb_masked .reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.mean(), wuhan, 1000, 1e9 ) .get('NO2_column_number_density') .getInfo(); console.log(`January 1-20 NO2 mean: ${jan_mean ? (jan_mean * 1e6).toFixed(2) : 'null'} μmol/m²`); console.log(`February 10-25 NO2 mean: ${feb_mean ? (feb_mean * 1e6).toFixed(2) : 'null'} μmol/m²`); // Validate results if (jan_mean === null || feb_mean === null || isNaN(jan_mean) || isNaN(feb_mean)) { console.log('Calculation returned invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check if values are in reasonable range (0-500 μmol/m²) const jan_umol = jan_mean * 1e6; const feb_umol = feb_mean * 1e6; if (jan_umol < 0 || jan_umol > 500 || feb_umol < 0 || feb_umol > 500) { console.log('NO2 values outside expected range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare: did NO2 decrease from January to February? const decrease = feb_umol < jan_umol; const diff = jan_umol - feb_umol; console.log(`Difference (Jan - Feb): ${diff.toFixed(2)} μmol/m²`); console.log(`NO2 decreased: ${decrease}`); if (decrease) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
